sample_unit: patients (development 50,366; internal validation 5,037; US external 20,541; European external 2,411; temporal 4,311)

links.outcome: Model performance across age, sex, and race subgroups in external validation
links.effect: In the US external validation set, median AUROCs across eight subgroups were above 0·81; overall SMR was 0·99 (0·96-1·03).
links.quote: In the external validation set (US population), the median AUROCs of bias evaluations covering eight subgroups were above 0·81, and the overall SMR was 0·99 (0·96-1·03).

links.outcome: Comparison of the ELDER-ICU XGBoost model against other ML algorithms and clinical scores
links.effect: XGBoost performed best in all validation types versus three other ML algorithms and five clinical scores; e.g., internal AUROC 0·866, external US 0·838.
links.quote: The final XGBoost model was compared against three other machine learning algorithms and five clinical scores.

unlisted_practices: Cohort-specific calibration of a predictive model before validation
Simplified model with top 20 features achieving similar performance to the full model

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter development and external/temporal validation with subgroup bias evaluation of a clinical risk prediction model (ELDER-ICU) without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or clinical workflow impact.
